name: Venom Bottles
summary: Bottles of a vile green venom fill a Witherbark village in the Hinterlands. So many of them suggest the Witherbarks value it highly, and an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill might like a sample.

sections.title: A Toxic Discovery
sections.body: The bottles in the Witherbark village hold a vile, green venom. There are so many that the Witherbarks must consider it very important. A sample could be carried to an apothecary in Tarren Mill, who may want to see it.

sections.title: Lydon's Verdict
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon, whose experiments have all failed that day, takes the bottle and declares the contents venom drawn from some arachnoid creature. Lydon asks where it came from.

faq.q: Where are the venom bottles found?
faq.answer: They are in a Witherbark village in the Hinterlands, in great numbers.

faq.q: Who is interested in the venom bottles?
aliases: where to turn in venom bottle
faq.answer: The suggestion is to take a sample to an apothecary in Tarren Mill, and Apothecary Lydon is the one to see.
A vile, green venom, and the Witherbarks seem to value it highly given how many bottles they keep.
